Our Expertise in Unity Development

Android Game Development

3D Game Development

We use Unity’s powerful 3D features to make game worlds that feel real and immerse you in them. Our attention to detail in everything we do, from character modeling to environment design, makes sure that your 3D game experience feels real and fun. Our Unity 3D developers are experts in a wide range of 3D game types and are setting new standards for the quality of both visual and interactive games.

Our Cooperation Models

Dedicated Unity Developer

With this plan, you have direct power over the development process and the developer works as an employee of your company. Mobilunity takes care of all the HR, financial, and administrative tasks so the developer can focus on doing great work without having to worry about anything else. This plan works great for long-term projects that need constant attention and deep knowledge of Unity. It also makes it easy for our developer to fit into your existing workflow.

Hire a Dedicated Unity Developer

Part-Time Unity Developer – Mobilunity FLEX

The service is designed for projects that need skilled Unity help but don’t want to hire Unity 3d developers full-time. For a small fee, this plan lets you directly find Unity developers. Mobilunity handles all HR tasks, accounting, and offers full help desk support. This makes sure that the expert is focused on your project and ready to meet its needs. You can hire remote Unity developers to support your team and bring in top-notch talent from around the world. This way, you can get access to top-notch knowledge from anywhere.

How to Hire Unity Developers with Mobilunity

{01}

Determine Your Needs

The first step in hiring a Unity developer with Mobilunity is to precisely identify your project requirements. Consider aspects such as the scope of your project, specific skills required, the timeline for development, and your budget. This clear understanding of your needs will enable us to provide you with the most suitable Unity developer candidates.

{02}

Get in Touch With Us Using the Form Below

Once you have a clear idea of your requirements, the next step is to reach out to us. You can easily do this by filling out the contact form provided below. This form is your initial point of communication with us, where you can share details about your project and what you are looking for in a Unity developer for hire.

{03}

Receive Estimate and Offer From Us

After reviewing your requirements, Mobilunity will provide you with an estimate and a tailored offer. This will include details on the proposed Unity developers, the scope of services, timelines, and the pricing model. Our aim is to offer a comprehensive solution that aligns perfectly with your project’s objectives and budget.

{04}

Interviewing Candidates

Following the offer, we will arrange interviews with the selected Unity developer candidates. This step is crucial for ensuring that the developer’s skills, experience, and work approach align with your project’s needs. It also offers an opportunity for you to gauge the developer’s communication skills and overall compatibility with your team.

{05}

Start Your Cooperation

Once you have selected the ideal Unity developer for your project, the final step is to commence your cooperation. Mobilunity will facilitate a smooth onboarding process, ensuring that the developer integrates seamlessly into your team. From here, you can start working on your project with the support of your new, skilled Unity developer, backed by Mobilunity’s continuous assistance and expertise.

FAQ on Hiring Unity Developers

How much does it cost to hire Unity developers?

The cost of hiring a Unity Developer can vary significantly based on factors such as geographical location, level of expertise, and project complexity. In the United States, for instance, hourly rates for Unity Developers can range from $20 for those with less experience to over $100 for highly skilled Unity game developers for hire. Full-time salaries also show a wide range, starting from around $50,000 annually for beginners to above $120,000 for seasoned developers. We recommend conducting thorough market research and considering your specific project requirements to accurately budget for hiring a Unity Developer.

How complex is it to find Unity developers in Eastern Europe?

Locating Unity developers in Eastern Europe is a viable task, given the region’s rich pool of tech talent. Specifically, countries like Ukraine, Poland, Bulgaria, and Romania have become notable centers for skilled Unity developers. LinkedIn data reveals that Ukraine has around 3,200 Unity developers, Poland about 3,000, Romania hosts approximately 708, and Bulgaria has around 412 professionals in this field. This abundance is a testament to Eastern Europe’s strong technical education and burgeoning game development sector, making it a prime location for recruiting Unity talent.

Are you able to find developers with Unity3D and C# or another combination of stacks?

Yes, we are fully equipped to source developers with a diverse intersection of stacks, including Unity3D and C#. Our approach is tailored to match your specific project requirements, ensuring we find the right mix of expertise for your needs. Our extensive network and thorough vetting process allow us to identify and recruit developers with the precise skill sets you require, whether it’s for gaming, AR/VR, or any other Unity-based application.

How soon could you scale a team of 1 developer to a team of 4-5 Unity developers?

The process of scaling a team from one to four or five Unity developers typically takes about 3-4 weeks. We have the capability to search for multiple candidates simultaneously, thanks to our vast talent pool and efficient recruitment process. This ensures that we can quickly meet your need for a larger team, helping you accelerate your project timeline while maintaining the quality of talent. To bring your interactive visions to life with precision and innovation, hire Unity programmers who can seamlessly integrate into your project’s dynamic.

Do you help with technical interviewing of Unity candidates?

Yes, we offer assistance with the technical interviewing of Unity candidates as an additional service. We have trusted Senior-level Unity developers on our team who can help evaluate the technical skills and project fit of potential hires. This support ensures that you make informed hiring decisions, securing talent that aligns with your technical requirements and project goals. If you want to speed up the process of making games and improve the efficiency of your workflow, hire Unity Cloud Build developers. These developers are experts at using cloud-based technologies to make project merging and release go smoothly.
